tech_stack: React Native Web (Expo), Animated API, StyleSheet.create, Theme Tokens, i18n

theme_strategy.strict_token_enforcement: CRITICAL: Never use hardcoded hex values for colors. All colors MUST map through the `WC` theme context.

surface_treatment.light_mode: Crisp borders, stark contrast. Heavy use of subtle inset shadows to pop cards off the background.
surface_treatment.dark_mode: True deep surface. Use `withAlpha(WC.surface, 0.8)` combined with web-only `backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)'` for floating elements to avoid muddy grays.

hierarchy.h1: Aggressive scaling. Web: `clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px)`. Mobile: scaled down via RN Dimensions. Tight tracking, strong weight.
hierarchy.h2: Accent color applied to the second line of the headline to create immediate visual tension.
hierarchy.subtitle: High legibility, leading/line-height set to 1.6 for readability. Feature count ('37+') wrapped in a distinct pill.
hierarchy.microcopy: Uppercase, wide tracking for eyebrow badges.

card_replacements.value: Focuses on hyper-personalized AI fit scores & career calibration.
Highlights 3x faster promotion trajectories and live growth analytics.
Emphasizes 23-language support and worldwide active coach streaks.

mobile_phone_under_480.sequence: Badge -> Headline -> Subtitle -> Value Cards (horizontal scroll snap) -> CTAs -> Live Stats Row (stacked) -> Ticker Tape.
mobile_phone_under_480.mockup_panel: Hidden or heavily simplified into a small floating widget to save vertical space.

tablet.sequence: Same as mobile but Value Cards are in a 3-column grid.

desktop_wide.structure: Asymmetric Side-by-Side. Left: 55% Content. Right: 45% Mockup Panel.
desktop_wide.alignment: Left-aligned text for aggressive reading efficiency.
desktop_wide.mockup_panel: Sticky right-side, large, interactive 'Live Coach' chat representation overlaid with performance metric widgets.

badge.style: Pill-shaped, uppercase, `withAlpha(WC.accent, 0.1)` background, `WC.accent` text color. Add a pulsating dot indicator (using `Animated`) next to the text to signify 'Live / Active Platform'.

hero_cards_bento.style: Replace the boring linear layout with a mini 'Bento' setup for the 3 value cards. Web: `display: grid`. RN Web polyfill: flex wrap with specific percentages.

live_stats_row.style: Horizontal flex container containing 4 data points. Add dynamic '+N since landing' pill next to stats.

mockup_panel_desktop.style: Floating glass terminal. Render an AI Coach Chat interface.
elements: Body: 2-3 chat bubbles fading in to simulate active conversation.
Overlays: 3 floating widgets overlapping the chat container (Goals Hit %, Growth %, Sessions).

animated_api_rn.entrance: Staggered fade-up for left-column elements using `Animated.sequence` and `Animated.timing`. Transform `translateY` from 20 to 0.
animated_api_rn.delta_pills: On mount, delay 2s, then pop in the '+N' delta pills using `Animated.spring` to simulate live data arriving.

css_injected_web.ticker_tape: Inject a `<style>` tag dynamically that defines `@keyframes marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }`. Apply this to the ticker tape wrapper for buttery smooth infinite scroll.
css_injected_web.glass_blur: Add a raw CSS class via `<style>` for `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` to apply to the mockup panel and value cards on web.

ai_coach_avatar.description: Professional confident male mentor portrait for the Nova AI coach avatar.

ambient_texture.description: Abstract elegant wavy texture used as a subtle background layer for the right-side mockup panel (masked with low opacity).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the solution completely in React Native Web (Expo) using `StyleSheet.create`. No Tailwind, no raw CSS files.
Do NOT use `framer-motion`. Utilize `Animated.Value`, `Animated.timing`, and `Animated.spring` for interactive moments.
For the infinite ticker tape, create a React component that renders a `<style>` block containing the `@keyframes` and applies it via `className` or DOM injection.
Strictly pass all color assignments through the theme context variables (e.g., `theme.WC.text`, `theme.WC.surface`). Do NOT hardcode colors.
Replace the placeholder 3 cards with the new Buyer-Value proposition cards. Ensure they utilize the i18n structure provided.
On desktop (`width >= WELCOME_CENTERED_LAYOUT_BREAKPOINT`), mount the right-side mockup panel. Make it look like a premium, active dashboard chat with the provided mentor avatar.
Integrate `data-testid` on all CTAs, cards, and interactive mockup widgets.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Ensure dark mode and light mode are equally polished. Rely on `withAlpha()` for creating depth without breaking the token system.
Never use raw hex colors on elements.
Ensure the hero section does not look generic. Use layered `Animated.View` elements to create a z-index hierarchy and visual interest.
Make the 'Live Data' feel real: The '+N' delta pills should literally animate in after a delay to give a feeling of active platform usage.
Maintain high spacing multiples (e.g., padding/margin values of 24, 32, 48, 64) to ensure an enterprise 'pro-grade' breathing room.
